summary: Static portfolio content/positioning update verified end-to-end. All 7 UI-facing acceptance criteria covered by named browser checks; all passed. No API-bearing criteria in this matrix (static portfolio, no content DB) so no new backend test files were required; existing template /api/status endpoint confirmed healthy (200) as the wiring smoke check.

checks.criterion: Detailed personal first-person About Me, not generic bio
checks.name: about-me-detailed-narrative
checks.evidence: About section shows introduction + My Background (MAKAUT University, Future Institute of Engineering and Management, 2022-2026), My Technical Journey, What I'm Building, Where I'm Heading, technical summary; scanned for and found no unsupported employment/expert claims.

checks.name: hero-honest-technical-positioning
checks.evidence: Hero role badge reads 'Electrical Engineering graduate building a career in full-stack development, data analytics and AI'; 4 capability pillars are Full-Stack/Python & Data/AI-Powered Applications/Engineering & IoT; timeline item 1 = 'CURRENT TECHNICAL DIRECTION', items 2-4 = 'ADDITIONAL...' (event/ops secondary); skills filter 'Transferable' shows Team Coordination, 'All' shows React etc.

checks.criterion: Practical project and responsible AI-assisted learning narrative
checks.name: projects-in-progress-ai-assisted-learning
checks.evidence: 'What I'm Building' chapter text contains EventPulse and Industrial Motor Intelligence, states 'Both are in progress', and 'I review, test and improve the output'; Learn/Build/Test/Debug/Improve/Deploy/Document process chips all visible via about-process-* testids.

checks.criterion: Uploaded CV is usable from portfolio
checks.name: cv-link-downloads-pdf
checks.evidence: about-view-cv-link and resume-view-cv-button both href the supplied hosted PDF URL; clicking resume-view-cv-button triggered a real download event, download.failure() === null, suggestedFilename ends in .pdf.

checks.criterion: Accurate qualifications and contact from latest CV
checks.name: qualifications-modal-and-contact-details
checks.evidence: Modal shows B.Tech 2022-2026 CGPA 7.1 MAKAUT University, 12th CBSE 65.6%, 10th ICSE 79%, Java/Spring/Spring Boot internship certification; closes via Escape and via close button; nav-connect-cta, hero-email-button and contact-email-copy-button all use mailto:bhowmickatanu83@gmail.com.

checks.name: responsive-about-navigation-desktop
checks.evidence: Run against ingress APP_URL https://tech-events-ops.preview.emergentagent.com at 1280x720: chapter jump link scrolls to About > Where I'm Heading section, sticky header stays visible, no horizontal document overflow.

checks.name: responsive-about-navigation-mobile
checks.evidence: At 390x844: mobile menu opens/closes, nav link scrolls to About title, chapter jump link scrolls to My Technical Journey, header remains visible, no horizontal overflow, no failed network requests captured.

action_items: No API-bearing criteria present in this matrix (static portfolio; existing template /api/status verified 200 via curl pre-check per seed_facts) — no backend test files were added this iteration.
